exposure: Placenta previa location (complete previa, partial placenta previa, marginal previa, low-lying previa)
cohort: The study involved 150 pregnant women diagnosed with placenta previa.
finding: The location of placenta previa significantly influences pregnancy outcomes, with complete previa presenting the highest risk, including a 58.3% rate of preterm delivery and a 50% rate of antepartum hemorrhage.
mod_finding: Complete placenta previa was associated with a 96.7% cesarean section rate.
